Algorithm.description: Exact event-selection algorithm. All sample the same law; they differ in cost and random-word use.

Assessment.description: What a Direct SSA result may be used for.

Diagnostic.description: One structured finding with a stable code, the JSON Pointer of the input it concerns, a message and a repair hint.

code.description: Stable code such as `CRN-E012` or `CRN-W001`, part of the machine contract.

message.description: Human-readable detail; its wording is not part of the contract.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string denotes the document root.

Method.description: Method of an alternative-SSA request, selected by `kind`.

oneOf.description: `ssa`: an exact stochastic simulation algorithm with a waiting-time sampler and policy.

fast.description: Not allowed in ssa-run/0.1; default false in 0.2 and true in 0.3 and 0.4, except for next reaction, which is checked only. Emulates JumpProcesses.jl: Xoshiro256++ words, running totals updated by `+= new - old` without loss or 53-bit resolution checks, and stop polls per batch of events instead of per random word. Selection stays exact for the running totals; paths differ from the checked policy and replay only with the same setting.

Record.description: Accounting of one replicate; every requested id has exactly one record.

diagnostic.description: The diagnostic behind a `failed`, `population_limit` or `sampling_limit` stop.

events.description: Events executed; rejected candidates and refused updates are not counted.

id.description: Replicate id, which also selects its random stream.

saved_points.description: Save times for which a state was recorded, a prefix of the save grid.

started.description: False for a replicate that a stop prevented from starting.

stop_time.description: The latest certified time of the path in seconds; the horizon when completed.

ResultVersion.description: Schema tag of an alternative-SSA result; it matches the request version.

oneOf.description: Answers an ssa-run/0.1 request; `method` has no `fast` field.
Answers an ssa-run/0.2 request; `method` may carry `fast: true`.
Answers an ssa-run/0.3 request; `method.fast` is always present.
Answers an ssa-run/0.4 request; `method.fast` is always present.

Severity.description: Whether a diagnostic blocks use of the input or result: `error` does, `warning` is advisory.

Statistics.description: Ensemble statistics: one row per save time, one value per species. Present only for a fully completed ensemble.

mean_standard_error.description: Standard error of the mean, sqrt(variance / n), when `mean` was requested and n > 1.

sample_variance.description: Unbiased sample variance (denominator n − 1) when `variance` was requested.

samples.description: Number of replicates summarized, equal to the requested replicates.

Termination.description:
How a replicate, or the whole run, ended.

The declaration order is the aggregation priority: a run reports the largest replicate value, or `output_limit` when retained output was removed.

Trajectory.description: Saved states of one retained replicate.

counts.description: One row of counts in species order per recorded save time; only the replicate's `saved_points` rows if it stopped early.

id.description: Replicate id; trajectories are kept for ids 0 to `keep_trajectories` − 1.

Work.description: Work counters of a replicate or a whole run; for completed work they depend only on the inputs and seed.

point_fallbacks.description: Times an `rssa_cr` bound fell back to the propensity at the current state.

proposals.description: Channel selection attempts, including those composition–rejection rejected.

rejected_candidates.description: `rssa_cr` thinning rejections: the clock advanced but no reaction fired.

rng_words.description: 64-bit random words drawn, the quantity `max_sampling_steps_per_replicate` limits.

description: Alternative exact SSA result: method, identities, replicate accounting, work, trajectories and statistics.

diagnostics.description: Model warnings, plus `CRN-E064` when output was removed.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact model bytes.

replicates.description: One record per requested replicate, in id order.

run_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact request bytes.

sampler.description: Sampler identity: `chacha8-u53/ALGORITHM/WAIT/N` for the checked policy, with N = 2 for `direct_cr` and `rssa_cr` and 1 otherwise, and `xoshiro256pp-u53/ALGORITHM/WAIT/fast-1` for `fast`; WAIT is `inverse` or `ziggurat256-julia`. Replay needs the same identity, seed and input bytes.

save_times.description: The request's save grid in seconds.

species.description: Species names in the order used by every count row.

statistics.description: Requested statistics, present only when every replicate completed and output fit.

trajectories.description: Saved states of the first `keep_trajectories` replicates; empty when output was removed.
